meta.name: stitch-design-taste
meta.description: Semantic Design System Skill for Google Stitch. Generates agent-friendly DESIGN.md files that enforce premium, anti-generic UI standards — strict typography, calibrated color, asymmetric layouts, perpetual micro-motion, and hardware-accelerated performance.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为项目生成符合高级设计标准的 DESIGN.md 文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为项目建立严格、高质量的设计规范文档
copy.tagline_en: Generate DESIGN.md files enforcing premium UI standards for your project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to establish strict, high-quality design guidelines for your project

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会为 Google Stitch 生成一份 DESIGN.md 设计规范:写明配色(最多一个强调色)、字体、布局、动效参数,并列出禁止出现的 AI 设计套路,供后续生成界面时遵循。
howto.when: 当你准备用 Google Stitch 生成界面、或想先定一套统一设计规范时触发。默认基线为变异度 8、动效 6、密度 4,可随你的风格描述调整。

say.text: 帮我生成一份密度 4、变异度 8 的 DESIGN.md
say.note: 会产出含配色、字体、布局与禁令的规范文件

say.text: 做一个艺术画廊风格的落地页设计规范
say.note: 按该风格定调色板、字体与留白原则

say.text: 密度调到 8、动效降到 3,再生成一版 DESIGN.md
say.note: 高密度下数字改用等宽字体

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude generates a DESIGN.md spec for Google Stitch: color palette (max one accent), typography, layout, motion values, plus a banned anti-pattern list, to steer later screen generation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you plan to generate screens with Google Stitch or want a shared design spec first. Default baseline is variance 8, motion 6, density 4, adjustable from your style description.

say_en.text: Generate a DESIGN.md with density 4 and variance 8
say_en.note: Outputs a spec with color, type, layout and bans

say_en.text: Write a design spec for an art-gallery-style landing page
say_en.note: Sets palette, fonts and whitespace for that mood

say_en.text: Set density 8 and motion 3, then regenerate DESIGN.md
say_en.note: At high density, numbers switch to monospace
